website_summary.name: Shirt Customization Studio
website_summary.description: The website offers a sleek and interactive interface for users to customize their own shirts with various options and measurements.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a clean and organized layout designed for user-friendly interaction. It includes a prominent header titled "Customize Your Shirt," followed by a form divided into sections for selecting shirt models, fabrics, colors, and entering measurements such as neck, chest, waist, sleeve length, and shirt length. There is also a text area for additional notes. The design uses a floral white background color with dark goldenrod accents for buttons and other UI elements. The price is dynamically updated based on selections, and there is a "Generate Design" button at the bottom.
website_summary.functionality: The website enables users to customize shirts by choosing from predefined options like shirt models, fabrics, and colors. Users can input specific measurements for a personalized fit. Additional notes can be added for special requests. Once selections are made, users can generate a shirt design preview. The system calculates the total price based on the chosen options and allows users to proceed with ordering and payment.
